modules.application/service/models.py: Strict public request/result models and typed error envelope; no authority objects accepted from clients.
modules.application/service/facade.py: Small composition facade delegating scoped read/intake/queue/hold/worker/sync/receipt operations to focused use cases.
modules.application/service/{intake,actions,work: Use existing core/provider/runtime public APIs, durable operation IDs and current versions. No SQL or duplicated transition policy.
modules.config/{models,files,sessions}.py: Pinned operator configuration, confined private files, trusted host enrollment and persisted opaque session capabilities. CWD/user strings cannot select authority.
modules.adapters/decisions/{journal,authority}.p: Separate durable decision/session-resume/lead observation receipts. Delegated actions use an explicit trusted grant; actual human acceptance and host/AI/user receipts require trusted observed references, not model assertions.
modules.adapters/writing/{package,runner,journal: Verify pinned external Technical Writer package, run actual prepare/packet/review/finalize with structured argv in private storage, bind kind/style/reference/version/exact rendered content and metadata to opaque approvals. No guessed semantic review or arbitrary imported receipt trust.
modules.adapters/mcp/{server,tools}.py: Official pinned MCP SDK server over stdio; strict input schemas and genuine protocol/client tests. No handcrafted protocol, credentials on stdout or public authority-issuer tools.
Installable aitm group commands, JSON output, typed nonzero errors and scoped text lists with status symbols/color-free support.

authority_boundary.bootstrap: Trusted installer/host wrapper verifies actual Linear binding, enrolls a host logical-session grant and invokes internal session establishment. Model-visible tools cannot create arbitrary grants, principals or host observations. Public session-open/resume accepts only opaque pre-enrolled references and valid configured capabilities.
authority_boundary.decisions: General delegated queue/start/cancel/duplicate/hold requests may create only agent-actor decisions under an existing explicit scoped grant. Human acceptance/review exits and scope revision require an independently observed human-instruction reference from a trusted host/provider adapter. Missing host observation remains a typed refusal, never a fabricated human proof.
authority_boundary.writing: Semantic judgment is residual AI work performed from the actual frozen packet; self-review is honestly labelled. Code runs the validator and checks exact output/content/kind/version. Independent/human reviewer claims cannot be injected through model endpoints. Changing package bytes or approved prose invalidates publication.
authority_boundary.notifications: MCP tools expose scoped events and apply existing verified receipt references only. No event read/cursor advance or self-reported ack mints host delivery/AI/public evidence. Actual host observer integration is a separate dependency; unsupported modes remain pending.
authority_boundary.provider_runtime: Linear owns actual identity/status/ingress observations; runtime owns startup/resource/outcome observations. Service composes explicit verifier routes without catch-all authority or table writes.

packaging_proposal.request: Lead/runtime worker integration of a src wheel backend, project.scripts aitm entry point, and locked mcp==2.3.0 base SDK (not cli extra). Keep Python >=3.12 and product standalone; Technical Writer is an explicitly configured external pinned dependency. Do not edit shared pyproject/lock concurrently.
packaging_proposal.mechanical_test_env: Create private uv environment with reviewed SDK dependency after approval; tests import src and do not use credentials or live provider/model effects.

public_operations.name: session_resume
public_operations.output: new persisted capability; no token in normal stdout

public_operations.name: writing_prepare
public_operations.authority: configured scoped session; facts are content, not approval
public_operations.output: opaque writing id and actual source/guide-bound review packet

public_operations.name: writing_review
public_operations.authority: current host self-review only unless trusted reviewer observation exists
public_operations.output: accepted/rejected review result; no task effect

public_operations.name: writing_finalize
public_operations.authority: actual accepted validator review and unchanged exact draft/package

public_operations.name: task_submit
public_operations.output: pending intake/confirmed Backlog with explicit sync fact

public_operations.name: task_list
public_operations.output: only this session tasks; issue stage, execution and sync separate

public_operations.name: task_action
public_operations.authority: explicit delegated grant or actual human proof; core owns destination/evidence policy
public_operations.output: actual desired/observed/sync result; no raw set-status endpoint

public_operations.name: task_revise
public_operations.authority: actual human scope authorization + core quiescence

public_operations.name: task_progress
public_operations.authority: approved prose + configured actual publisher port
public_operations.output: publication/checkpoint receipt; missing publisher is explicit pending/refusal

public_operations.name: worker_start
public_operations.authority: delegated start grant + real runtime accounting and resource/provider gates
public_operations.output: actual attempt phase; no invented model startup

public_operations.name: worker_execute
public_operations.authority: current lease + trusted bounded accounted command plan

public_operations.name: event_list
public_operations.output: scoped durable events; read is not acknowledgement

public_operations.name: sync_now
public_operations.output: immediate pending outbox/inbox application summary; no broad backlog scan

cli_contract: aitm --config <pinned-private-config> --session-file <private-capability> [--json] <session|writing|task|worker|event|sync> <action>. Complex inputs via bounded JSON stdin/file. No secrets/tokens printed or accepted as ordinary positional arguments. CLI groups map to the same service operations as MCP.
open_integration_dependencies: Actual trusted host enrollment/human message/lead trace observations must be supplied by installer/host adapter; model self-report cannot substitute.
Reviewed Linear/runtime branches must be integrated for final composition.
Progress comment publication needs an actual provider operation or remains explicitly unavailable.
Actual both-host installed execution is later acceptance, not established by SDK client tests.
